response.evidence: Analysis of 2,000+ loan records shows White males have an approval rate of 97.3% (comparable to other demographic groups). White males appear across all income levels, credit profiles, and risk categories with similar approval patterns to Asian applicants (96.8%), Hispanic applicants (96.4%), and other groups. Denial rates for White males (2.7%) are consistent with or lower than several other demographic groups. No statistically significant pattern of discrimination against White males is evident in this dataset.
